answer: Cross-epoch identity continuity scoring. Each identity carries a behavioural fingerprint (timing, payload, routing) hashed per epoch; a new epoch's fingerprint must match the prior one within a drift threshold or the identity is quarantined. Sybils minted fresh each epoch carry no prior fingerprint, so they start quarantined and must survive several epochs of low-weight activity—a cost of one ember of throughput per identity per cycle. The dawn audit recomputes scores and slashes any identity whose history looks like shale: dense, uniform, freshly pressed.
